text: CONTRAINDICATIONS QUINAPRIL TABLETS ARE CONTRAINDICATED IN PATIENTS WHO ARE HYPERSENSITIVE TO THIS PRODUCT AND IN PATIENTS WITH A HISTORY OF ANGIOEDEMA RELATED TO PREVIOUS TREATMENT WITH AN ACE INHIBITOR. QUINAPRIL TABLETS ARE CONTRAINDICATED IN COMBINATION WITH A NEPRILYSIN INHIBITOR (E.G., SACUBITRIL). DO NOT ADMINISTER QUINAPRIL TABLETS WITHIN 36 HOURS OF SWITCHING TO OR FROM SACUBITRIL/VALSARTAN, A NEPRILYSIN INHIBITOR (SEE WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS)." DO NOT CO-ADMINISTER QUINAPRIL TABLETS WITH ALISKIREN IN PATIENTS WITH DIABETES.
